sentences.en: I went at once; otherwise I should have missed him.
sentences.zh: 我立刻就去了；否则我就错过他了。

sentences.en: I ran and ran; otherwise I might have been late.
sentences.zh: 我跑得飞快；否则我就迟到了。

sentences.en: We started at once, otherwise we would have missed him.
sentences.zh: 我们立刻出发了；否则我们就错过他了。

senses.zh: 另外的；其他方面的；原本，本来
